text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. T-Trainer?! D-Did you just see 
that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... To tell the truth, I ended up 
binge-reading some manga I borrowed from a 
friend...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it was really so interesting! I 
ended up borrowing all the sequels too!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, I'll make sure not to stay up late 
next time!"
